skill.summary: Selects fair random winners, runner-ups, or teams from participant lists and spreadsheets.

content.value_statement: Selecting giveaway winners manually can look biased and take extra time. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code choose random winners from lists or spreadsheets with clear selection details.
actual_capabilities: Selects one or multiple random winners from plain lists, CSV files, Excel files, or Google Sheets.
Excludes previous winners to prevent duplicate selection.
Supports weighted selection using an entries column.
Can choose runner-ups along with primary winners.
Reports winner details, timestamp, and selection method for transparency.
Can split participants into random teams.
limitations: It relies on the AI tool's available file or sheet access permissions.
It does not verify legal eligibility or contest compliance.
It cannot prove fairness unless inputs, seed, and process are preserved.
It may expose personal data if winner details are shared without review.

use_cases.title: Run a Subscriber Giveaway
use_cases.description: Pick one winner and backup winners from a newsletter, community, or form export.

use_cases.title: Select Event Raffle Winners
use_cases.description: Choose multiple attendees from a CSV or spreadsheet and record the selection details.

use_cases.title: Assign Random Teams
use_cases.description: Split a participant list into balanced random groups for testing, workshops, or activities.

prompt_templates.title: Pick One Winner
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a small list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick one random winner from this list. Show the total number of entries, the winner, and the selection time.

prompt_templates.title: Pick Multiple Winners
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a local file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick five random winners from entries.csv. Do not select the same person twice. Include three runner-ups.

prompt_templates.title: Use Weighted Entries
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick one winner using the entries column as ticket weight. Explain the total ticket count and selection method.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Public Drawing
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for transparent giveaway records.
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick one winner and three runner-ups from this Google Sheet. Exclude prior winners and provide a concise audit note for publication.

output_examples.input: Pick one winner from a list of 247 giveaway entries.
output_examples.output: Winner selected: Sarah Johnson from row 142. Total entries: 247. Selection method: secure random choice. Timestamp included for records.

output_examples.input: Pick one winner and three runner-ups from an event attendee spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: Primary winner and three runner-ups are listed with row numbers. Duplicate entries were excluded before selection.

output_examples.input: Split 24 participants into four random teams.
output_examples.output: Four teams of six participants are returned. Each participant appears once, and the assignment time is included.

best_practices: Verify the entry list before selection and remove ineligible records first.
Keep the timestamp, selection method, and source file for audit records.
Review winner contact details before sharing any public announcement.
anti_patterns: Do not run a drawing before confirming contest rules and eligibility.
Do not publish private emails, phone numbers, or addresses without consent.
Do not change the entry list after selection without recording why.

faq.question: Can it select winners from Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Google Sheets examples, subject to the AI tool's access permissions.

faq.question: Can it pick more than one winner?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports multiple winners and runner-ups while avoiding duplicate winners.

faq.question: Does it support weighted raffles?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use an entries column so one participant can have multiple tickets.

faq.question: Can it prove that a drawing was fair?
faq.answer: It can report the method, timestamp, and source details. Keep the original entries for independent review.

faq.question: Does it check contest legality?
faq.answer: No. You must verify rules, eligibility, and legal requirements before announcing winners.

faq.question: Can it create random teams?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a workflow for splitting participants into equal random teams.
